text:
nora_sales: New presales ask from CitriBank: 30-day POC, Canada-only for inference, logs, and backups. BYOK (customer HSM, FIPS required). They also want no EU egress and a redacted subprocessor list showing any party that could touch request metadata. Need delta pricing vs hosted and peering lead time. @cal_sre @eva_security @sam_legal

cal_sre: Quick: hosted API can't promise strict CA-only because control-plane telemetry can cross regions. Options: Private single-region (guaranteed) or Dedicated tenant pinned to ca-central-1 with deny rules. If they insist on zero control-plane egress, recommend Private.

cal_sre: Short routing example we use: tenant_pin=ca-central-1; allowed=[ca-central-1]; deny=[eu-*]; failover=[]

eva_security: We can share a redacted, region-filtered subprocessor summary pre-NDA (cloud infra, logging pipeline, monitoring). Full inventory and SOC reports require NDA. BYOK/HSM: customer HSM supported in Private; Dedicated supports managed-HSM with compliance review. Key onboarding + attestation ~7-14 business days.

sam_legal: We can add a limited "no EU egress" POC amendment but must define exceptions (emergency security alerts, legal requests, critical patches). Ask their counsel to confirm scope: data plane only or control+management plane. NDA required for full subproc list.

peering_ops: For peering we need CIDRs, ASN, bandwidth, and TLS SANs. Typical provisioning 3-10 business days depending on carrier. Note: cross-region failover will produce egress charges; include in SOW.

cal_sre: Ballpark POC pricing: Private single-region w/ BYOK/HSM onboarding ~$28k-$38k for month (includes onboarding). Dedicated pinned POC ~$14k-$20k/mo + managed-HSM ~$3k-$4k/mo + one-time peering ~$1k-$2k. Will refine with GPU profile.

eva_security: I'll prepare a CA-filtered redacted subproc summary and partial security QA we can share pre-NDA.

sam_legal: I'll draft NDA + short POC amendment language and follow up on acceptable exceptions. Need customer legal contact.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Created ticket PRESALES-3177 -> ca-poc-byo-hsm, assigned infra+security+peering.

nora_sales: Thanks all. I'll send NDA and their security questionnaire. Please DM formal quote and a 1-page ops checklist I can include in the SOW. :thumbsup:
